details: Manual-started collector still requests genuine native price data and permits only provenance-verified no-trade continuity.
No parameter, calibration, dataset, model selection or fitted model is transferred.
Draft PR187 is stacked on existing published collector PR139; source integration is separate from local installation.
Peer installation and future live timing are unverified; no reciprocal acceptance or operational gate.
limitations: Saved requests establish delayed first attempts but do not identify every caller or prove one exclusive cause.
A provider request already in flight still completes normally; this repair does not guarantee provider publication or punctual network delivery.
Based on the existing published candle collector in draft PR 139; main does not yet contain that source dependency.
runtime_implications: Local source repair loads on the next human manual start. No trader launch or restart, provider or broker calls, manual-stop change, or model-policy change.
summary: Atlas repaired collector backlog scheduling so new quarter-hour intervals receive priority.
